blurb:
Combine the best of Dallas with a visit to the world-famous Southfork Ranch in one unforgettable 4.5-hour experience. Your adventure begins with a narrated Dallas Highlights Tour, where you'll see many of the city's most iconic landmarks before traveling to Southfork Ranch, the legendary home of the Ewing family from the hit TV series Dallas.

At Southfork Ranch, you'll spend approximately 1 hour 30–45 minutes, including the official guided tour of the Ewing Mansion and free time to explore the property at your own pace. Visit the gift shop, stroll the beautiful ranch grounds, take memorable photos, and experience the location that became famous around the world.

Whether you're a longtime fan of Dallas or simply looking for a unique Texas experience, this tour combines the history and highlights of Dallas with one of the state's most recognizable attractions—all with comfortable transportation and expert local commentary.
